snippet.title: The First Descendant: Breakthrough | Hover Bike Teaser
snippet.description:
This summer, get a first look at the hover bike that will race across the vast Axion Plains.
For more details about the upcoming mega update "Breakthrough," check out the dev stream from PAX East!
👉 https://youtube.com/live/tNdje4dwrD0?feature=share

PLAY FREE NOW: https://tfd.nexon.com/

The First Descendant is a next generation third-person co-op action RPG shooter (looter shooter) featuring high-quality graphics developed using Unreal Engine 5. It presents fun strategic boss fights through 4-player co-op, various unique characters, exciting gunplay, and looting.
